title: DNA Interaction and Cleavage Modes of Anthraquinone-Fused Enediynes: A Study on Tiancimycins, Yangpumicins, and Their Semisynthetic Analogues.
authors: Wen, Zhongqing; Zhuang, Zhoukang; Liu, Huiming; Wang, Zilong; Feng, Xueqiong; Zhu, Xiangcheng; Yan, Xiaohui; Duan, Yanwen; Huang, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蒽醌融合烯二炔类化合物与DNA的结合及切割模式，采用分子动力学模拟揭示其插入/嵌入机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移借鉴。
abstract: Dynemicin A has been the sole prototypical anthraquinone-fused enediyne (AFE) explored since its discovery in 1989. This study investigates the distinct DNA binding and cleavage mechanisms of emerging AFEs, represented by tiancimycins and yangpumicins, along with semisynthetic analogues. Our findings reveal their potent cytotoxicity against various tumor cell lines, while 18-methoxy tiancimycin A treatment could significantly suppress breast tumor growth with minimal toxicity. One of the most potent AFEs, i.e., tiancimycin A, preferentially targets DNA sequences 5'-ATT, 5'-CTT, 5'-GAA, 5'-GAT, and 5'-TTA. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that emerging AFEs intercalate deeper into AT-rich DNA base pairs compared to dynemicin A. Importantly, tiancimycin A may equilibrate between insertional and intercalative modes without deintercalation, enabling selective cleavage of T and A bases. This study underscores how subtle structural variations among AFEs significantly influence their DNA recognition and cleavage, facilitating future design of novel AFEs as potent and selective payloads for antibody-drug conjugates.
abstract_zh: Dynemicin A自1989年发现以来，一直是唯一被探索的原型蒽醌融合烯二炔（AFE）。本研究探讨了新兴AFE（以tiancimycins和yangpumicins为代表）及其半合成类似物的独特DNA结合与切割机制。我们的研究结果揭示了它们对多种肿瘤细胞系的强效细胞毒性，而18-甲氧基tiancimycin A处理能显著抑制乳腺肿瘤生长且毒性极小。最具效力的AFE之一，即tiancimycin A，优先靶向DNA序列5'-ATT、5'-CTT、5'-GAA、5'-GAT和5'-TTA。分子动力学模拟表明，与dynemicin A相比，新兴AFE能更深入地嵌入富含AT的DNA碱基对中。重要的是，tiancimycin A可能在插入和嵌入模式之间达到平衡而无需脱嵌入，从而实现对T和A碱基的选择性切割。本研究强调了AFE间细微的结构变异如何显著影响其DNA识别与切割，为未来设计新型AFE作为高效选择性抗体-药物偶联物载荷提供了便利。
